occurrence.window: The panzootic has been running since the clade 2.3.4.4b genomic change at the end of the 2010s, but three dated things make 2026 the anchor rather than 2022: over 50,000 common crane carcasses were collected along the western European flyway in under two months at the end of 2025, drone surveys at Heard Island in October 2025 and January 2026 put average southern elephant seal pup mortality at 76 per cent, and Australia, the last clean continent, went from its first detections to 498 reported animals across six states within three or four months. The commercial consequences run on a separate and slower clock: the USDA national poultry vaccination framework is the live decision, and the chain repricing it would cause sits roughly 2027 to 2030.

title: The H5N1 panzootic: the money is not where the dead birds are
thesis: H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b stopped being a poultry disease that wild birds carry between sheds and became a self-sustaining epidemic in the wild that spills back into farming. Public attention holds exactly one link of the resulting chain, the egg-price trade, and that link has already repriced: Cal-Maine's fiscal 2026 results carry the reset, and the same USDA series that shows egg VALUE up 49 per cent in 2025 shows egg VOLUME down 4 per cent, which is a supply shock being paid for rather than an opportunity being discovered. The un-mapped part is the rest of the chain, and its shape is unusual: the two tightest choke points are privately held. The world's broiler and layer genetics sit inside EW Group and Hendrix Genetics, and EW Group also owns VALO BioMedia, one of the two leading producers of the specific-pathogen-free eggs that egg-based human influenza vaccines are grown in. The other SPF leader, AVS Bio, was carved out of Charles River by a private investor group in December 2022. So a large pool of money is moving, and the fraction of it that reaches a listed issuer at the points of greatest scarcity is close to zero. That inversion, enormous money at stake with weak public reach exactly where the bottleneck is, is the finding, and it is the opposite of what a first pass at this occurrence would assume.
why_now: Three dated things landed inside twelve months and none of them is a poultry story. Over 50,000 common cranes died along the western European migration route at the end of 2025, in under two months, on a flyway that had never been hit. Australian Antarctic Division drone surveys at Heard Island in October 2025 and January 2026 measured 76 per cent average southern elephant seal pup mortality, up to 97 per cent in one harem, out of roughly 17,000 pups. Australia, which monitors better than most of the world and had stayed clean, recorded 498 animals across six states within three or four months, with wild foxes among them. On the commercial side the fuse is the USDA national poultry vaccination framework, which has been in planning since 2025 and still has not been authorised for field use: the Zoetis H5N2 conditional license has existed since February 2025 and the decision to deploy it is a trade decision, not a veterinary one. That decision, whenever it comes, reprices the animal-vaccine link and the depopulation link in opposite directions.
retail_gap: This machine can measure the gap on itself, which is rare. Upstream's intake plane currently holds 800 feed items across 19 sources, and exactly one of them mentions avian influenza at all: an incidental line inside an unrelated Australian live-news blog. Nineteen sources spanning wires, financial press, technology press, the Federal Register, SEC releases, seismic and disaster alerting, and not one animal-health, veterinary or agricultural source among them. The occurrence's own author makes the same claim from the other side, that nobody discusses it outside the world of epidemic researchers. Where coverage does exist it is almost entirely about eggs at the supermarket and about pandemic risk to humans, which are the first and last links of a chain with eight links in between. Nothing found in a full sweep maps the middle: who supplies the genetics, who supplies the disinfectant, who disposes of a hundred million carcasses, who processes the eggs that survive, and who grows the eggs that human vaccines are made in.

unmappedness.rationale: Scored high and the card states its own denominator rather than asserting the gap. The occurrence itself is not secret: WOAH publishes on it, the Australian Antarctic Division put out a press release, and the trade press covers the USDA vaccination question. What is unmapped is the chain, and three independent reads agree. First, this repository: 13 themes, 13 chains, 442 issuer market files and 361 logged occurrences before today, and not one of them touches avian influenza, poultry, agriculture, animal health or food supply, so a new theme had to be created to hold this. Second, the intake plane: 1 of 800 feed items, and that one incidental. Third, and the reason this is not scored higher, the retail-visible link genuinely is well covered and has already moved, so the card is not claiming the whole occurrence is undiscovered. It is claiming the discovered part is one link out of ten, and that the two links with real pricing power are not investable at all, which is a finding that only a chain build can confirm or destroy.
